Zuberi, M.J.S., Hasanbeigi, A. and Morrow, W. (2022). Electrification of industrial boilers in the USA: potentials, challenges, and policy implications. Energy Efficiency 15, 70. https://doi.org/10.1007/s12053-022-10079-0

Loaded: electric boiler assumptions (efficiency 99%, range 95-99%; >350 degC, >70 bar, up to >70 MWe; capex 13-44 printed "$/GJ" converted to 46.8-158.4 2018 $/kW, installed; O&M 1%/yr; lifetime 20 yr; discount rate 10%); 2050 abatement cost range 67-185 $/tCO2; combustion boiler sector-weighted efficiencies (HHV) printed in the text for five sectors; boiler service lifetime up to 50 yr. _other-values: printed capex unit, relative capex, fuel emission factors (Table 1), prices, potentials, cost-of-conserved-energy ranges, Table 3 all-manufacturing demand by size class. Not loaded: sector/state tables 2, 4, 5 and per-sector rows of Table 3 (statistics, not technology data); Fig. 2 power law, Fig. 9 and Fig. 10 values (charts without printed numbers). Locator: printed page numbers ("Page X of 28") equal PDF pages. Traps: capex unit printed as $/GJ is almost certainly $ per MJ/h of capacity (consistent with Fig. 2 in $/kW and with DOE tipsheet doe_2024_002, which reprints the same data from Zuberi et al. 2021); capacity basis (thermal output) assumed. Price year 2018 from figure axes.
